messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync 1 need a rollout that supports per-tenant region-pin + automated fallback to a cheaper cost-tier. avoid oscillation and keep fallback SLAs. suggestions?
Ravi (Eng): shadow-first for pinned tenants, then soft-redirect (5%). shadow lets us collect per-tenant deltas without affecting traffic.
Priya (SRE): agree. require sticky-session routing for pinned tenants to keep KV cache warm. allocate isolated canary/fallback pools to avoid noisy neighbors.
Zoe (Data): telemetry ask: per-tenant quality score, p50/p95 latency, tokens generated, fallback-count, and a rolling 3h delta. need daily batch evals too.
Ken (Solutions): customers insist on fallback SLA. propose fallback p95 < 200ms hosted, < 300ms dedicated. we'll include terms in opt-in docs.
Omar (Compliance): for private/VPC tenants, block opt-in until KMS rotation proof + audit events emitted on each fallback decision.
Maya (PM): AB plan? within-pin or cohort split?
Ravi (Eng): recommend within-pin AB for pilots (50/50), safer for small tenants. cohort AB later for retention signals.
Priya (SRE): guardrails: auto circuit-breaker when fallback-rate > 2% AND p95 latency regression > 40%. auto-roll to global fallback pool if repeated fallbacks for same tenant (3x in 10m).
Ravi (Eng): add cached-response fallback for idempotent prefixes seen within 30m to reduce load during overload.
Zoe (Data): experiment thresholds: min 1000 requests or 95% power to detect 1% quality diff. short window 3h, mid 24h, AB length 7d typical.
Ken (Solutions): communication: 48h notice for enterprise opt-ins, include escape-hatch steps + billing for fallback usage.
Maya (PM): kill criteria proposal?
Ravi (Eng): kill if any: sustained p95 > 2x baseline for 30m, token-error-rate > 1% for 15m, fallback-rate > 5% for 30m with upward trend. manual rollback allowed by SRE/PM.
Priya (SRE): infra thresholds: GPU OOM or node CPU >90% for 10m -> immediate degrade. KV thrash >4x baseline -> rolling throttle.
Omar (Compliance): all automated rollback reasons must be recorded in audit log for postmortems.
Maya (PM): timeline: week0 infra+telemetry+docs, week1 shadow+within-pin AB on internal tenants, week2 5% soft-redirect, week3 ramp to 25% and enable customer opt-ins if gates pass.
Ravi (Eng): action items: flag PR + sticky TTL, sticky hashing prototype today.
Priya (SRE): allocate fallback pools in us-west-2 + eu-west-1; add Prom rules and runbook.
Zoe (Data): prepare canonical prompts + synthetic burst workload for shadow.
Ken (Solutions): draft opt-in template and SLA language.
Omar (Compliance): KMS checklist posted; legal signoff required before opt-ins.
deploy-bot: shadow mode can be enabled 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC for internal tenants per schedule.
Maya (PM): decision: proceed shadow-first + within-pin AB + strict infra gates. I'll assemble rollout checklist and post to launch-room. thanks :tada:
